limitations: The source Fusion export is immutable evidence and is never edited.
For mixed PETG/Steel occurrences, the source mass and volume are decomposed using the two exported material densities; the Steel-derived mass is then replaced by component masses.

Occurrence center of mass is retained from Fusion and inertia terms are scaled uniformly by estimated_mass/raw_mass. This is deliberately coarse because the current export lacks per-body physical properties.
Missing base electronics are included only in the total mass budget. Their poses and inertias remain unresolved.
This file is suitable for an initial Gazebo model, not hardware validation, actuator sizing, tip-over certification, or structural analysis.

aggregate_center_of_mass_and_inertia.reason: Missing base proxy poses and per-body properties prevent an honest aggregate correction. Resolve them when producing canonical link inertias.
